items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Les Paul used to come up a lot with his guitar. ... We used to, after the last hour, they used to sit in and play.

ctx.x: picture for us of what was going on so that we can feel it.

They had a place like, even like Billy Daniels used to go to Monroe's Place, after hours places, where they'd go down and have, where they'd have their after hours drink. They had a band down there in one of the clubs what they called a tramp band. Redd Foxx used to play along the strings of a bass. And then, we used to take our horns down there and have a little jam session. People would send us drinks. We would play there until 10:00 in the morning. We had musicians from different other bands used to come out.…

I remember Louis Armstrong come in there once. And after I finished the Savoy Ballroom, he carried me to, I think it was Brickwood, to sit down and talk to me about saving my lips, not overblowing. He said you may need those in the years that are coming. He said now, you made your point. Now, take it a little easy so you can have those for years to come. He said, he had some trouble with his once. He had to have some meat grafted on his bottom lip. Louis. Right there. So, he didn't want me to go through that, you…
